messages.body_plain:
Additionally, https://www.phosphosite.org/ can help you by providing a ranked list of kinases for a given phosphorylated protein.

On Wednesday, October 30, 2024 at 5:28:35 PM UTC-4 antho...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hi,
>
> MSstatsPTM performs differential abundance analysis for PTMs, including phosphorylated proteins.  You can use MSstatsPTM to compare phosphorylation levels in control versus treated samples (e.g., drug-treated cells, diseased versus healthy tissues) and calculate fold changes or significance of phosphorylation differences.
>
> The kinase activity can then be inferred from changes in phosphorylation patterns across these conditions because phospho sites with significant increases or decreases are often associated with kinase activation or inhibition.  Additionally, biomolecular knowledge databases like INDRA DB <https://db.indra.bio/search> can be used in tandem with MSstatsPTM to map phosphorylated proteins back to their known kinases.
>
> Thanks,
> Tony
>

> > Hello,
> > Is it possible to use the output of MSStatPTM to find kinase substrate analysis?
